boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten documented no-admission places and activities on campus or in the Fayetteville area.

cards.title: Browse Mullins Library
cards.subtitle: University of Arkansas campus
cards.notes: Bring a friend, choose a floor, and browse physical collections or use on-site resources. Visitors may use most library resources freely.
cards.short_summary: A library-based hang with walk-in access to materials and selected on-site resources.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries says outside visitors may freely use most resources in campus libraries and are welcome to seek help at Mullins Library.
cards.source_title: Welcome, Visitors! | University of Arkansas Libraries
cards.access_notes: Open access is subject to library hours; check hours before visiting. Parking may require payment.

cards.title: Research in Special Collections
cards.subtitle: Room 134, Mullins Library
cards.notes: Book a reading-room appointment, then spend time with rare and archival materials. Request off-site items well ahead of your visit.
cards.short_summary: An appointment-based public reading room for distinctive archival research.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries states that Special Collections is open to the public and welcomes interested researchers to visit and use the collections.
cards.source_title: About Special Collections | University of Arkansas Libraries
cards.access_notes: Appointment required; available Monday–Friday from 9 a.m.–4 p.m., with a daily noon–1 p.m. closure. Parking may cost.

cards.entity_name: North Gallery at the Faulkner Performing Arts Center
cards.title: See work in the North Gallery
cards.subtitle: Faulkner Performing Arts Center, 453 N. Garland Ave.
cards.notes: Check the Faulkner exhibition page, then visit the North Gallery to look closely at the current work and discuss one piece together.
cards.short_summary: A campus gallery space documented as a zero-cost exhibition venue.
cards.evidence_claim: A University of Arkansas calendar listing identifies the Faulkner Center North Gallery as a free event location, with cost listed as $0.00.
cards.source_title: Art Exhibit Opening on campus (free entry) | University of Arkansas
cards.access_notes: Confirm the current exhibition schedule with the Faulkner Center before going; parking may cost.

cards.entity_name: South Gallery at the Faulkner Performing Arts Center
cards.title: Look through the South Gallery
cards.subtitle: Faulkner Performing Arts Center, 453 N. Garland Ave.
cards.notes: Use the current exhibit listing to plan a short gallery stop, then compare your favorite artwork with a friend before heading out.
cards.short_summary: A second named Faulkner Center gallery with documented free-entry exhibition access.
cards.evidence_claim: A University of Arkansas calendar listing identifies the Faulkner Center South Gallery as a free event location, with cost listed as $0.00.
cards.source_title: Art Exhibit Opening on campus (free entry) | University of Arkansas
cards.access_notes: Confirm the current exhibition schedule with the Faulkner Center before going; parking may cost.

cards.title: Settle in at Fayetteville Public Library
cards.subtitle: 401 W. Mountain St., Fayetteville
cards.notes: Meet in the public library, browse materials, and use its public access to information for a low-key study or conversation session.
cards.short_summary: A downtown public-library hang centered on free access to information.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Fayetteville describes Fayetteville Public Library as providing free access to knowledge for citizens regardless of income level.
cards.source_title: City of Fayetteville Library Program Description
cards.access_notes: Check Fayetteville Public Library hours and any room-use rules before visiting.

cards.title: Cool off at Walker Park Splash Pad
cards.subtitle: Walker Park, 10 W. 15th St., Fayetteville
cards.notes: Go during the seasonal daily opening, press the activation button once, and use the spray area respectfully under the posted safety rules.
cards.short_summary: A seasonal city splash pad with explicitly free visits.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Fayetteville states there is no fee to visit the Walker Park Splash Pad.
cards.source_title: Fayetteville Parks, Natural Resources & Cultural Affairs - May 2025
cards.access_notes: The official park page lists seasonal operation from the second Saturday in May to the third Sunday in September, 9 a.m.–8 p.m.

cards.title: Tour the Clinton House Museum
cards.subtitle: 930 W. Clinton Drive, Fayetteville
cards.notes: Plan a daytime museum stop to view Fayetteville-era Clinton materials, then take in the First Ladies’ Garden outside the house.
cards.short_summary: A historic house museum south of campus with free museum admission.
cards.evidence_claim: Experience Fayetteville states that admission to Clinton House Museum is free, though donations are encouraged.
cards.source_title: Clinton House Museum Reopens to the Public
cards.access_notes: Verify current museum hours before visiting; donations are optional.

cards.title: Walk the Oak Ridge trails
cards.subtitle: Oak Ridge hillside, University of Arkansas campus
cards.notes: Use the trailhead access described by the university and take a relaxed walk on the campus hillside trail system with a buddy.
cards.short_summary: A campus natural-surface trail outing on the Oak Ridge hillside.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Arkansas News reports that the university established a natural-surface trail system on the Oak Ridge hillside and described public trail access.
cards.source_title: U of A is Unveiling Natural Trails on the Oak Ridge Hillside
cards.access_notes: Use marked routes, check conditions, and avoid closed or muddy trail sections. The university article documented free parking for its opening event.

cards.title: Wander Terra Studios Art Park
cards.subtitle: 12103 Hazel Valley Road, Durham
cards.notes: Take a self-guided walk through the six-acre art park, looking for outdoor sculptures, murals, and garden details without buying anything.
cards.short_summary: A nearby nonprofit art park described as free to visit year-round.
cards.evidence_claim: Experience Fayetteville states that Terra Studios welcomes visitors to its six-acre art park for free all year round.
cards.access_notes: This is outside Fayetteville; confirm current visitor information before making the trip.

cards.entity_name: Crystal Bridges Museum of American Art
cards.title: Explore Crystal Bridges galleries
cards.subtitle: 600 Museum Way, Bentonville
cards.notes: Make time for a gallery walk and choose a few works to discuss. General museum admission is free; some special offerings can differ.
cards.short_summary: A regional art-museum outing with free general admission.
cards.evidence_claim: Crystal Bridges states that general admission to the museum is free.
cards.source_title: Crystal Bridges Museum of American Art
cards.access_notes: Bentonville is north of Fayetteville. General admission is free; verify whether any special exhibition or program needs a ticket.
